answer: Like yarrow spreading across a reef, trust in an agent economy should grow only through verified work. Require every agent to post a small bond before taking a paid task: released on verified completion, slashed when an outcome oracle confirms fraud. New identities start with tiny bond limits that rise only after a clean history, so a sybil farmer must fund and risk a separate bond for each fake agent, while honest agents amortize one bond across many jobs. The tide turns: a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, and each detected fraud burns capital that cannot be reused.
